title: Image Pipeline Atomic Pack
description: Atomic, reusable visual transformation. Contains controlled English prompt terms with variance/entropy so the generator can apply precise or flexible language.

id.description: Stable unique id, e.g. photographer.helmut-newton, medium.watercolor, treatment.heavy-noir, atmosphere.possessive

prompt_terms.description: 1–10 English terms or short phrases that describe the visual effect. These are the primary payload injected into the image prompt. Each term carries a variance (entropy) score.

term.description: Exact English word or short phrase to consider for the prompt (e.g. "Helmut Newton", "heavy noir contrast", "glossy luminous skin")

variance.description: 0.0 = must use the exact term (or extremely close paraphrase). 1.0 = high freedom to rephrase, substitute synonyms, or drop if needed. Photographers and precise proper names should be near 0.0. Atmospheric or treatment terms can be higher.

weight.description: Relative importance of this term inside the pack (optional)

content.description: Optional free-form extra data (notes, examples, negative prompts, etc.)
